Venezia, by contrast, are rooted to the bottom of the standings with just three points from nine outings — one win and eight losses — and a form line of LLWLL.

The fixture pits the division's fifth-best attack (17 goals scored) against its leakiest defence (19 goals conceded). Como have also been solid at the back, shipping only eight goals, while Venezia have managed a mere six goals all season.
